title: Whole Turkey (frozen)

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes are planned for the target week. Recent weeks show no consistent trend, with sales fluctuating around the baseline (median 3.2). The week of 2026-07-13 (9 units) was high but not driven by a known event or promotion. Past promotions had noisy, unreplicated effects; noise-adjusted estimates are at x1.0. The baseline’s uncertainty (109% noise) justifies no spread change.
